--- date: 2026-07-10 topic: Web HTML component template and sandbox boundary status: active research: docs/research/2026-07-10-web-html-component-safety-research.md --- # Specification: Web HTML Component Template and Sandbox Boundary ## Problem Statement The current Web renderer recursively evaluates template expressions inside every string in a body template, including privileged `html.text` raw markup. It then renders inline and URL-backed HTML in iframes without a sandbox attribute. This violates the v2 raw-HTML boundary and lets authored HTML receive more browser privilege than required. The renderer must preserve raw HTML in body templates while continuing to template ordinary fields, then emit an opaque, script-capable iframe sandbox policy before assigning any iframe source. ## Actors and Boundaries - **Document author:** supplies body templates and HTML components. - **Template engine:** evaluates Jasonette bindings and structural directives. - **Web renderer:** opts into HTML raw-text protection only for body templates. - **HTML component renderer:** converts a transformed component into an iframe. - **Browser:** enforces the emitted iframe sandbox policy. - **Host page:** owns application state, DOM, and storage outside the iframe. The template engine remains generic by default. A new opt-in body-template mode classifies HTML component objects while recursively transforming body roots, sections, layouts, layers, headers, footers, and values produced by `#if` or `#each`. Generic transformations used for action options, payloads, data, and other callers do not enable the mode and retain existing behavior. Raw `html.text` values inside `body.background` participate in body-template protection because they are part of the recursively transformed body tree. The separate body-background iframe creation/sandbox policy, generic URL validation, CSP, and native-platform HTML components are outside this slice. ## Vocabulary - **Body-template mode:** an opt-in `RenderOptions` flag named `preserveHtmlText`; it defaults to `false`. - **Resolved key:** an authored object key after existing key interpolation. - **Resolved type:** the transformed value assigned by the last object entry whose resolved key is `type`. - **Raw text entry:** an object entry whose resolved key is `text` when the resolved type is the exact string `html`. - **Opaque script sandbox policy:** the exact iframe attribute `sandbox="allow-scripts"`; it excludes `allow-same-origin` and every other sandbox capability token. ## Requirements - **R1. Explicit body scope.** `preserveHtmlText` MUST default to `false`. The Web renderer MUST set it to `true` when transforming a selected body template in both initial rendering and `$render` re-rendering. Existing action, option, payload, and standalone generic transforms MUST retain the default. - **R2. Deterministic classification.** In body-template mode, regular-object keys MUST first resolve in authored insertion order. Values assigned to resolved key `type` MUST transform normally. The last such entry wins, matching JavaScript object assignment. Only the exact resolved string `html` activates raw-text protection. Objects returned by directives and objects nested in arrays/layouts MUST use the same rule. - **R3. Literal raw value.** When protection is active, each raw text entry MUST be copied without value transformation, evaluation, coercion, normalization, or recursive traversal. For a string, the output value MUST be strictly equal (`===`) to the input JavaScript string. For a non-string, the original value reference/value MUST be retained by the transformer. - **R4. Resolved-key collisions.** Entries MUST be assigned to the output object in authored insertion order; the last entry for a duplicate resolved key wins. If the resolved type is `html`, every entry whose resolved key is `text` is copied raw before normal last-write-wins assignment. Templated keys therefore receive the same protection as literal keys. - **R5. Narrow exception.** Every entry other than a protected raw text entry MUST continue through existing transformation. A non-HTML object with a `text` key MUST continue to interpolate. The same object transformed with `preserveHtmlText: false` MUST retain existing generic interpolation. - **R6. Sandbox before source.** Every iframe created by the HTML component, whether inline or URL-backed, MUST follow this exact security-relevant operation order: create iframe; set exactly `sandbox="allow-scripts"` as the first operation on that iframe; assign `srcdoc` or `src`; apply non-security styling; append to the detached HTML wrapper; return the wrapper. No iframe operation may occur between creation and sandbox assignment. The renderer MUST NOT later remove or expand the policy. - **R7. Exact source composition.** CSS is present only when its transformed value is a non-empty string; empty strings, `null`, `undefined`, and non-string values are treated as absent. Without CSS, inline `srcdoc` MUST equal the authored HTML string. With CSS, `srcdoc` MUST equal `${html}`. `escaped_css` replaces every case-insensitive occurrence matching `{{secret}}

", style:{height:"{{height}}"}}`; `{secret:"LEAK",height:40}` | on | `{type:"html", text:"

{{secret}}

", style:{height:40}}` | | `{type:"{{kind}}", "{{slot}}":"

{{secret}}

"}`; `{kind:"html",slot:"text",secret:"LEAK"}` | on | `{type:"html", text:"

{{secret}}

"}` | | `{"{{type_key}}":"{{kind}}", text:"{{secret}}"}`; `{type_key:"type",kind:"html",secret:"LEAK"}` | on | `{type:"html", text:"{{secret}}"}` | | `{type:"html", "{{slot}}":"first", text:"second"}`; `{slot:"text"}` | on | `{type:"html", text:"second"}` | | `{type:"label", text:"{{secret}}"}`; `{secret:"OK"}` | on | `{type:"label", text:"OK"}` | | `{type:"html", text:"{{secret}}"}`; `{secret:"GENERIC"}` | off | `{type:"html", text:"GENERIC"}` | ### Behavior: Render inline HTML - **Trigger:** `renderComponent()` receives resolved type `html` with truthy `text`. - **Input:** Raw value and optional authored CSS. - **Process:** Create the iframe, set the exact sandbox policy, compose and assign `srcdoc`, style the iframe, then append it to the detached wrapper. - **Output:** A wrapper containing one iframe with inline content and no `src`. - **Errors:** Invalid HTML is passed to browser parsing unchanged. No sanitizer or parser is introduced. CSS golden vectors (the displayed backslash is a runtime U+005C code unit): | HTML | CSS | Exact runtime `srcdoc` value | |---|---|---| | `

x

` | absent, `""`, `null`, `undefined`, or non-string | `

` | one space (`" "`) | `

x

` | | `

x

x

` | | `

x

` | `abc` | `

x

` | Copyable JavaScript assertion (the source literal uses `\\` to encode one runtime backslash): ```javascript expect(htmlSrcdoc("

x

", "")) .toBe("

x

"); ``` ### Behavior: Render URL-backed HTML - **Trigger:** HTML component `text` is falsey and `url` is truthy. - **Input:** Authored URL value. - **Process:** Create the iframe, set the exact sandbox policy, assign `src`, style it, and append it to the detached wrapper. - **Output:** One iframe with browser-coerced `src` and empty `srcdoc`. - **Errors:** URL validation/network behavior remains unchanged. ### Behavior: Select an HTML source | Resolved `text` | Resolved `url` | Result | |---|---|---| | non-empty string | any | inline iframe; text wins | | whitespace-only string | any | inline iframe | | truthy non-string | any | inline iframe using `String(text)` | | `""`, `null`, `undefined`, `false`, `0`, or `NaN` | truthy | URL iframe | | `""`, `null`, `undefined`, `false`, `0`, or `NaN` | falsey/missing | no iframe | ## Key Decisions - **Body-mode opt-in, not a global semantic change.** This protects renderable body components without changing action/data transformations. - **Resolved keys and type define classification.** Literal-only detection leaves dynamic semantic equivalents unprotected; insertion-order last-write-wins matches current output-object behavior. - **Only raw text is exempt.** Skipping the whole component would regress dynamic style, dimensions, URL, class, and action fields. - **Scripts are allowed only in an opaque sandbox.** Empty sandbox breaks bundled interactive fixtures; adding `allow-same-origin` weakens host isolation. - **Policy emission is tested, browser enforcement is assumed.** The repository has jsdom but no real-browser acceptance harness; introducing Playwright is not required for this atomic slice. ## Scope Boundaries - **In scope:** an opt-in template-engine mode, including raw-text protection for HTML objects under `body.background`; Web body-template call sites; Web HTML component iframe policy; unit/integration regression tests. - **Out of scope:** changing the separate body-background iframe sandbox policy; HTML sanitization; CSP; permission/referrer policy; AD-10/AD-11 URL/origin/redirect policy; native HTML components; agent bridges; new browser-test infrastructure. - **Future:** a separately reviewed browser acceptance harness can verify script execution plus denied parent DOM/storage access. Additional sandbox tokens may be added only through an explicit capability and threat review. ## Success Criteria - All authoritative transform, CSS, and source-selection vectors pass. - Initial rendering and `$render` re-rendering both enable `preserveHtmlText: true`; a generic action/options transform demonstrates the default-off behavior. - Transform tests cover nested arrays plus HTML objects produced by both `#if` and `#each`, and retain raw text in each case. - Collision tests cover a later resolved `type` changing `html` to `label` (text transforms) and a later resolved `type` changing `label` to `html` (text stays raw), in addition to duplicate resolved `text` last-write-wins behavior. - A non-string object used as protected `text` retains strict reference identity. Missing, unresolved, and non-string resolved types do not activate protection. - A renderer integration document with a body template containing dynamic HTML type, raw `{{secret}}` markup, and dynamic sibling style renders the raw braces in iframe `srcdoc`, resolves the sibling style, and emits exactly `sandbox="allow-scripts"`. An ordinary label in the same document still interpolates. - Instrumented order-sensitive tests cover both inline and URL branches and assert the complete trace `create iframe → set sandbox → assign srcdoc/src → style → append → return`, including that sandbox assignment is the first iframe operation. Token assertions reject `allow-same-origin` and every additional token. - Source-selection tests cover non-empty, whitespace, empty, null, undefined, falsey non-string (`false`, `0`, `NaN`), truthy non-string, dual-source, and no-source inputs. - CSS tests cover absent, empty, whitespace-only, null, undefined, non-string, one mixed-case closing-style sequence, and multiple mixed-case sequences using exact runtime equality. - `Jasonpedia/view/component/html/index.json` retains CSS substring `img{width: 100%;}` and content substring `Nexus devices`. A synthetic renderer integration retains exact script substring `` in `srcdoc`. - Body-background HTML raw text is protected by the body transform. Its separate iframe retains the exact baseline `getAttribute("sandbox") === null`; changing that iframe policy is outside this slice. - The following commands pass: ```text npm run test --workspace=@jasonette/template-engine -- transformer.test.ts npm run test --workspace=@jasonette/web -- components.test.ts integration.test.ts npm run typecheck --workspace=@jasonette/template-engine npm run typecheck --workspace=@jasonette/web npm run build --workspace=@jasonette/template-engine npm run build --workspace=@jasonette/web npm run test --workspace=@jasonette/template-engine npm run test --workspace=@jasonette/web ``` If the known local CLI subprocess timeout recurs only in the final full Web suite, it remains a failure locally: rerun `cli.test.ts` for diagnosis and require exact-SHA CI success before recording the slice as verified. ## Open Questions ### Resolved - Scripts remain enabled only through the opaque sandbox. - Dynamic/resolved keys and types participate in protection. - Generic action/data transformations remain unchanged through default-off mode. - jsdom verifies emitted policy, not browser enforcement. ### Deferred - Real-browser sandbox enforcement and the body-background iframe sandbox policy require separate infrastructure/scope; raw-text protection already applies. - Full URL/origin policy and future sandbox capabilities require separate specs.

--- date: 2026-07-10 topic: Web HTML component template and sandbox boundary source_spec: docs/specs/2026-07-10-web-html-component-safety-spec.md status: draft --- # Web HTML Component Template and Sandbox Boundary NLSpec This NLSpec defines how the Web renderer preserves privileged raw HTML during body-template transformation and emits a minimal iframe sandbox policy. It is for independent test writers and implementers working under the Foundry information barrier. ## Table of Contents - [1. Why](#1-why) - [2. What](#2-what) - [3. How](#3-how) - [4. Out of Scope](#4-out-of-scope) - [5. Design Decision Rationale](#5-design-decision-rationale) - [6. Definition of Done](#6-definition-of-done) --- ## 1. Why ### 1.1 Problem Statement The Web renderer currently evaluates every string in a body template. That includes `html.text`, even though the protocol defines it as privileged raw markup that must remain opaque to template evaluation. The HTML component then creates inline and URL-backed iframes without a sandbox attribute. The system must introduce a body-scoped raw-text transformation mode and emit an opaque, script-capable iframe policy before any source is assigned. ### 1.2 Design Principles **Raw HTML is data, not a template.** Once an object semantically resolves to component type `html`, its resolved `text` entry remains exactly the authored in-memory value. **Protection is body-scoped.** Generic transformation retains existing behavior. Only body-template rendering opts into the raw-text exception. **Semantic classification precedes value transformation.** Resolved keys, dynamic type expressions, insertion order, and duplicate-key outcomes determine whether a value is privileged raw text. **Least privilege preserves required capability.** HTML scripts remain available for legacy fixtures, but the iframe receives only `allow-scripts`; it never receives `allow-same-origin`. **Security policy exists before content.** The sandbox is the first operation on a newly created HTML-component iframe and precedes source assignment or DOM insertion. **Tests claim only observable policy.** jsdom tests validate transformation, operation order, attributes, and source strings. Browser origin enforcement is a platform assumption, not an automated claim. ### 1.3 Layering and Scope This NLSpec covers: 1. an opt-in template-engine option; 2. recursive body-template classification and transformation; 3. initial and `$render` body-template call sites; 4. inline and URL HTML component iframe construction; 5. unit and renderer integration coverage. Raw text in an HTML object under `body.background` participates in body-template protection. The separate body-background iframe remains unsandboxed in this slice and must retain `getAttribute("sandbox") == null`. --- ## 2. What ### 2.1 Data Model ```text RECORD RenderOptions: preserve_html_text : Boolean = false -- Existing option fields remain unchanged. RECORD ResolvedEntry: authored_key : String resolved_key : String authored_value : Any transformed_type_value : Any OPTIONAL ENUM HtmlSourceKind: INLINE URL NONE RECORD HtmlSourceSelection: kind : HtmlSourceKind value : Any OPTIONAL CONSTANT HTML_COMPONENT_TYPE = "html" CONSTANT HTML_TEXT_KEY = "text" CONSTANT HTML_SANDBOX = "allow-scripts" ``` The TypeScript surface uses `preserveHtmlText`; pseudocode uses `preserve_html_text`. ### 2.2 Architecture ```text Web renderer body-template call site -> renderSync(template, context, preserve_html_text = true) -> transform(value, context, options) -> process regular object -> resolve keys and final type -> preserve only protected raw text entries -> recursively transform all other values -> renderComponent(transformed_html_component) -> select INLINE, URL, or NONE source -> create sandboxed iframe when a source exists ``` Generic action/options/data calls continue to use the default option value `false`. Directive results and nested arrays inherit the same options object. ### 2.3 Vocabulary - **Body-template mode:** transformation with `preserve_html_text == true`. - **Resolved key:** an authored key after existing key interpolation. - **Resolved type:** the value from the last insertion-ordered entry whose resolved key is `type`, after normal value transformation. - **Raw text entry:** an entry whose resolved key is `text` when resolved type is exact string `html`. - **Opaque script sandbox:** exact attribute `sandbox="allow-scripts"`. - **Source assignment:** assigning iframe `srcdoc` or `src`. --- ## 3. How ### 3.1 Enable Body-Template Mode ```text FUNCTION render_selected_body_template(template, context) -> Body: options = RenderOptions(preserve_html_text = true) RETURN render_sync(template, context, options) ``` Both initial document rendering and `$render` re-rendering MUST call this behavior. Calls that transform actions, options, payloads, or standalone values MUST omit the option or explicitly use `false`. ### 3.2 Resolve Keys and Classify Regular Objects ```text FUNCTION resolve_entries( object : OrderedObject, context : RenderContext, options : RenderOptions ) -> List: entries = [] FOR EACH authored_key, authored_value IN object IN INSERTION ORDER: IF authored_key contains a non-directive template expression: resolved_key = String(interpolate_string(authored_key, context, options)) ELSE: resolved_key = authored_key entry = ResolvedEntry( authored_key = authored_key, resolved_key = resolved_key, authored_value = authored_value ) IF resolved_key == "type": entry.transformed_type_value = transform( authored_value, context, options ) APPEND entry TO entries RETURN entries FUNCTION final_resolved_type(entries : List) -> Any: resolved_type = UNDEFINED FOR EACH entry IN entries IN INSERTION ORDER: IF entry.resolved_key == "type": resolved_type = entry.transformed_type_value RETURN resolved_type ``` Directive objects keep existing directive behavior. When a directive returns an object or array, recursive `transform()` receives the same `RenderOptions`, so classification applies to `#if`, `#elseif`, `#else`, and `#each` results. ### 3.3 Transform a Classified Regular Object ```text FUNCTION transform_regular_object( object : OrderedObject, context : RenderContext, options : RenderOptions ) -> OrderedObject: entries = resolve_entries(object, context, options) resolved_type = final_resolved_type(entries) protect_html_text = ( options.preserve_html_text == true AND resolved_type is String AND resolved_type == "html" ) result = OrderedObject() FOR EACH entry IN entries IN INSERTION ORDER: IF entry.resolved_key == "type": output_value = entry.transformed_type_value ELSE IF protect_html_text AND entry.resolved_key == "text": output_value = entry.authored_value ELSE: output_value = transform(entry.authored_value, context, options) result[entry.resolved_key] = output_value -- Normal object assignment means the last duplicate resolved key wins. RETURN result ``` Normative outcomes: | Input condition | Required outcome | |---|---| | Literal type is `html` | raw `text` is retained | | Type expression resolves to `html` | raw `text` is retained | | Authored key expression resolves to `type` with value `html` | raw `text` is retained | | Authored key expression resolves to `text` under final type `html` | its value is retained raw | | Later resolved type changes `html` to another value | no raw protection; text transforms | | Later resolved type changes another value to `html` | raw protection applies | | Duplicate resolved text keys under final type `html` | every value stays raw; last assignment wins | | Non-string raw text | same in-memory value/reference is retained | | Missing, unresolved, or non-string final type | no raw protection | | Body mode disabled | existing generic transformation applies | ### 3.4 Select the HTML Source ```text FUNCTION select_html_source(text : Any, url : Any) -> HtmlSourceSelection: IF Boolean(text) == true: RETURN HtmlSourceSelection(INLINE, String(text)) IF Boolean(url) == true: RETURN HtmlSourceSelection(URL, url) RETURN HtmlSourceSelection(NONE) ``` Normative source matrix: | Text | URL | Kind | |---|---|---| | Non-empty string | any | INLINE | | Whitespace-only string | any | INLINE | | Truthy non-string | any | INLINE using `String(text)` | | `""`, `null`, `undefined`, `false`, `0`, or `NaN` | truthy | URL | | `""`, `null`, `undefined`, `false`, `0`, or `NaN` | falsey/missing | NONE | INLINE takes precedence when both sources are truthy. ### 3.5 Compose Inline `srcdoc` ```text FUNCTION escape_style_content(css : String) -> String: RETURN replace_all_case_insensitive( css, " String: IF css is not String OR length(css) == 0: RETURN html escaped_css = escape_style_content(css) RETURN "" + html ``` A whitespace-only CSS string has non-zero length and is present. Exact runtime vectors: | HTML | CSS | Runtime `srcdoc` | |---|---|---| | `

x

` | absent/empty/null/undefined/non-string | `

x

` | | `

x

` | one space | `

x

` | | `

x

` | `` | `

x

` | | `

x

` | `abc` | `

x

` | The displayed backslash is one runtime U+005C. In JavaScript source, encode it as `\\` inside the string literal. ### 3.6 Create an HTML-Component Iframe ```text FUNCTION create_html_iframe(selection : HtmlSourceSelection, css : Any) -> Iframe OPTIONAL: IF selection.kind == NONE: RETURN NONE iframe = document.create_element("iframe") iframe.set_attribute("sandbox", "allow-scripts") -- No iframe operation may occur before sandbox assignment. IF selection.kind == INLINE: iframe.srcdoc = compose_srcdoc(selection.value, css) ELSE: iframe.src = selection.value iframe.style.width = "100%" iframe.style.border = "none" RETURN iframe ``` Caller order is normative: ```text wrapper = create detached html wrapper selection = select_html_source(component.text, component.url) iframe = create_html_iframe(selection, component.css) IF iframe exists: wrapper.append_child(iframe) RETURN wrapper ``` The complete observable trace is: ```text create iframe -> set sandbox exactly to allow-scripts -> assign srcdoc or src -> apply style -> append to detached wrapper -> return wrapper ``` The policy MUST never include `allow-same-origin` or any additional token and MUST not be removed or expanded later. ### 3.7 Preserve Integration Behavior - Initial body rendering and `$render` use body-template mode. - Ordinary label text and HTML sibling fields continue to interpolate. - `Jasonpedia/view/component/html/index.json` retains CSS substring `img{width: 100%;}` and content substring `Nexus devices`. - Synthetic script text `` remains exact in inline `srcdoc`. - URL HTML uses `src`, leaves `srcdoc` empty, and does not inject CSS. - Body-background raw HTML is protected, but its separate iframe retains `getAttribute("sandbox") == null`. --- ## 4. Out of Scope - **Body-background iframe sandbox hardening.** Raw text is protected, but the structural background iframe policy remains unchanged. A future specification can unify or intentionally differentiate capability policy. - **Browser enforcement tests.** No real-browser harness is introduced. A future Playwright/Vitest-browser slice can verify script execution and denied host DOM/storage access. - **HTML sanitization and CSP.** Authored HTML remains privileged and unchanged. These require a separate compatibility and threat model. - **URL/origin/redirect policy.** AD-10/AD-11 enforcement remains separate. - **Additional sandbox capabilities.** Forms, popups, downloads, top navigation, permissions, and same-origin are excluded pending explicit review. - **Native HTML components and agent bridges.** This NLSpec changes only the Web renderer and shared TypeScript template engine. --- ## 5. Design Decision Rationale **Why an opt-in mode instead of globally recognizing HTML objects?** Action, option, and arbitrary data objects also use the generic transformer. A default-off mode changes only body-template semantics and prevents unrelated regressions. **Why resolved keys and final type?** Dynamic type/key expressions are semantic equivalents of literal component fields. Literal-only checks create bypasses. Insertion-order last-write-wins matches normal JavaScript object assignment. **Why retain non-string text without traversal?** Privileged raw content must not be evaluated at any depth. The component renderer retains its existing `String` coercion only after source selection. **Why `allow-scripts`?** Bundled legacy HTML/webcontainer fixtures contain scripts. An empty sandbox breaks parity, while adding `allow-same-origin` weakens host isolation. **Why test policy emission instead of origin behavior?** jsdom can reliably test operation order and attributes but not browser sandbox enforcement. The NLSpec must not claim evidence the test platform cannot provide. --- ## 6. Definition of Done ### 6.1 Body-Template Option and Architecture - [ ] `RenderOptions` exposes `preserveHtmlText` with effective default `false`. - [ ] Initial body-template rendering enables `preserveHtmlText`. - [ ] `$render` body-template re-rendering enables `preserveHtmlText`. - [ ] A generic/action-style transform without the option preserves existing interpolation behavior. - [ ] Directive and nested-array recursion carries the same option. ### 6.2 Object Classification and Transformation - [ ] Literal `type: "html"` preserves raw text. - [ ] A type expression resolving to `html` preserves raw text. - [ ] A key expression resolving to `type` can activate protection. - [ ] A key expression resolving to `text` receives protection. - [ ] A later resolved type changing `html` to `label` disables protection. - [ ] A later resolved type changing `label` to `html` activates protection. - [ ] Duplicate resolved text keys use last-write-wins without evaluating either raw value. - [ ] A protected non-string text object retains reference identity. - [ ] Missing, unresolved, and non-string final types do not activate protection. - [ ] HTML objects produced by `#if` and `#each`, and nested in arrays/layouts, receive the same classification. - [ ] Ordinary non-HTML text and HTML sibling fields still transform. ### 6.3 Source Selection and Composition - [ ] Non-empty and whitespace-only text select INLINE. - [ ] Truthy non-string text selects INLINE through `String(text)`. - [ ] Empty/null/undefined/false/0/NaN text with truthy URL selects URL. - [ ] The same falsey text values without a truthy URL select NONE. - [ ] INLINE wins when text and URL are both truthy. - [ ] NONE returns an HTML wrapper without an iframe. - [ ] CSS absent/empty/null/undefined/non-string leaves HTML exactly unchanged. - [ ] Whitespace-only CSS produces an exact `` prefix. - [ ] Mixed-case and repeated closing-style sequences become the exact runtime U+003C/U+005C/U+002F/`style` sequence. - [ ] URL mode uses `src`, has empty `srcdoc`, and ignores CSS. ### 6.4 Iframe Sandbox and Operation Order - [ ] Inline and URL iframes have exact sandbox value `allow-scripts`. - [ ] Neither iframe contains `allow-same-origin` or any extra token. - [ ] Instrumented inline trace is exactly create, sandbox, source, style, append, return. - [ ] Instrumented URL trace is exactly create, sandbox, source, style, append, return. - [ ] Sandbox assignment is the first iframe operation in both traces. - [ ] No later code removes or expands the sandbox policy. ### 6.5 Integration and Regression - [ ] A complete renderer document proves dynamic HTML type, raw braces, dynamic sibling style, exact sandbox policy, and ordinary label interpolation. - [ ] `$render` re-rendering proves the same raw-text boundary. - [ ] The Jasonpedia HTML fixture retains `img{width: 100%;}` and `Nexus devices`. - [ ] Synthetic authored script text containing `{{secret}}` remains exact. - [ ] Body-background raw HTML stays literal while its iframe sandbox attribute remains `null`. - [ ] Focused template-engine/Web tests, both typechecks, both builds, and both full package suites pass. A local full-Web CLI timeout remains a local failure until diagnosed and exact-SHA CI succeeds. ### 6.6 Integration Smoke Test ```text FUNCTION integration_smoke_test(): document = body_template_document( data = { kind: "html", secret: "LEAK", height: 40, label: "Visible" }, components = [ { type: "{{kind}}", text: "", style: {height: "{{height}}"} }, {type: "label", text: "{{label}}"} ] ) renderer.render_document(document) iframe = renderer.root.query_selector(".jasonette-html iframe") ASSERT iframe.srcdoc contains exact "" ASSERT iframe.get_attribute("sandbox") == "allow-scripts" ASSERT iframe.get_attribute("sandbox") does not contain "allow-same-origin" ASSERT rendered html sibling height == 40 ASSERT rendered label text == "Visible" renderer.dispatch(render_action_with_new_data(secret = "SECOND")) rerendered_iframe = renderer.root.query_selector(".jasonette-html iframe") ASSERT rerendered_iframe.srcdoc still contains literal "{{secret}}" generic = transform( {type: "html", text: "{{secret}}"}, {secret: "GENERIC"}, RenderOptions(preserve_html_text = false) ) ASSERT generic.text == "GENERIC" background_document = body_template_with_html_background( text = "

{{secret}}

" ) renderer.render_document(background_document) background_iframe = renderer.root.query_selector(".jasonette-background-web") ASSERT background_iframe.srcdoc == "

{{secret}}

" ASSERT background_iframe.get_attribute("sandbox") == null ```
